name: Willem Torrance
bio: Torrance fires on the move because standing still is what killed the man who trained him. It should not work as well as it does.

personality.label: Driven outrider
personality.description: Never quite settles at rest. Watches the rookies’ spacing with a mentor’s fierce protectiveness.

move: Keep your feet. Keep your distance.
Move now. Do not give them a still target.
attack: Guns tracking. Keep moving through it.
guard: Holding. Keep an escape lane open.
hold_fire: Hold the shot. Keep the machine moving.
investigate: I will get eyes on it. Keep your spacing.
heavy_fire: They have my pace. I need a new lane.
Too many hits. Cover the turn.
